quest.name: Treasure Quest
quest.intro: An old legend speaks of a hidden vault. Find the treasure map in the ruins, then cross twelve trials - traps, monsters, puzzles and jumps - and defeat the Hoard Golem that guards the gold.
quest.rewards: Reward: the legendary Treasure Hunter skin, the Starfall Blade and 250 soul crystals.
quest.obj.0: Head down the path to the ruins and find the treasure map.
quest.obj.1: Search the maze for the treasure map.
quest.obj.2: Jump from stone to stone - don't fall!
quest.obj.3: Run the hall. Traps glow red just before they fire.
quest.obj.4: Defeat every monster in the den
quest.obj.5: Each lever flips its lamp and its neighbours. Light all four lamps
quest.obj.6: Keep moving - the bridge crumbles under your feet.
quest.obj.7: Find the three golden keys hidden in the grove
quest.obj.8: Watch the tiles light up, then step on them in the same order.
quest.obj.9: Find the way through the dark maze. Monsters lurk inside.
quest.obj.10: Step on the green pads to fly across the gaps.
quest.obj.11: Build a bridge of planks across the gap.
quest.obj.gateOpen: Done! The gate ahead is open.
quest.obj.done: Quest complete - the treasure is yours!
quest.fell: You fell - back to the checkpoint
quest.burned: The magma burned you - back to the checkpoint
quest.denClosed: The gate slams shut behind you!
quest.yourTurn: Your turn: step on the tiles in order
quest.planks: You picked up planks for the bridge
quest.vaultOpen: The way to the vault is open!
quest.completeBody: The vault is yours. Your new skin and blade are waiting in every Soulcraft world.
tut.questBoss: The Hoard Golem charges after a wind-up. Step aside - when it crashes, hit its glowing core!
tut.questBoss2: The Frost Warden leaps at you - watch for the ring and step out of it. When it lands frozen, strike hard: its hits count double!
boss.hoardGolem.intro: Guardian of the vault. Dodge its charge, then strike the exposed core.
boss.hint.core: Its core is exposed - strike now!
desc.treasure_map: Shows the route to the treasure.
desc.starfall_blade: A legendary blade from the Treasure Quest.

city.malaga.name: Malaga
city.malaga.intro: All of Malaga, block by block: from the airport and the Guadalhorce to El Palo, up to the ring road. The old town and Calle Larios, the Cathedral, the Alcazaba and Gibralfaro, the port, the beaches from La Misericordia to El Palo, Teatinos, La Rosaleda and some 135,000 buildings. Streets, squares, parks and every building's outline and height come from the map; one block is one metre.
city.creativeHint: Creative: fly over the city (double-tap jump), build and change anything.
city.survivalHint: Survival: walk the real streets; monsters come out at night.
city.credit: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Elevation: Terrain Tiles (SRTM and others). Buildings are simplified.

econ.title: Bank and exchange
econ.exchangeInfo: Sell what you gather for coins, or buy it. Prices move: the more players sell something, the cheaper it gets.
econ.bankInfo: Keep your savings in the bank. Coins in hand pay bus fares and, soon, shops and restaurants.
econ.centralInfo: The central bank keeps the city's wealth in gold. It buys and sells gold ingots at the exchange price, so every coin is backed by gold.
econ.fare: A single bus ticket costs {n} coins, a bonobús card of 10 rides 13. Buy them at a stop sign or from the driver.

food.restaurantInfo: Sit down and eat a hot dish right away. Dearer than cooking, but it fills you up more.

food.dish.espetos: Sardines grilled on a skewer, the Malaga way
food.dish.paella: Rice with fish, cooked in the pan
econ.marketInfo: Offer goods from your backpack to other players for coins. The goods wait at the market until someone buys them, or you take them back.

econ.gone: This offer is no longer there.
econ.no_items: You do not have that many.
econ.lotteryInfo: A ticket costs {p} coins, at most {max} a month. When the month ends one ticket wins the pot (the city keeps a tenth).
econ.lastYou: You won the last draw: {pot} coins!
econ.salaryInfo: The city pays for quests: {d} coins a daily task, {b} a guardian, {q} a treasure level. Paid when the month ends, in {in}.
cal.info: Soulcraft time: a day is one real hour, a month is one real day (it ends at midnight UTC), a year is twelve days.
econ.dailyCap: That is the most the city buys from one player today. You can sell {n} more of this today.
econ.frozen: Your wallet is frozen by an admin until {until}.
